{{Quotation|game|Named for a wise old Centaur with a penchant for peaceful living, visitors to this outpost do their business among the roots of a gargantuan [[stonewood]] tree, the largest known specimen of its kind.}}
Surrounded by [[Ettin's Back]], [[Ventari's Refuge]] is a small outpost that is named for its [[Ventari|peaceable resident centaur]].  Ventari's Refuge does not serve a different purpose than any of the other outposts of [[Maguuma Jungle]].

==Getting there==
The primary quest [[White Mantle Wrath: Demagogue's Vanguard]] will lead [[character]]s from [[Quarrel Falls]] to this outpost. The quest is not required to enter.

; From [[Lion's Arch]]

Exit to [[North Kryta Province]] and travel north-west to enter [[Nebo Terrace]], then travel south-south-west to [[Cursed Lands]]. From here take one of the two west exits to [[The Black Curtain]]; taking the northwest portal allows you to unlock [[Temple of the Ages]].

From the Black Curtain, use the west exit to reach the [[Talmark Wilderness]] and continue west through [[Majesty's Rest]], the [[Sage Lands]], [[Mamnoon Lagoon]], and eventually into [[Silverwood]]. From there, take the south exit to [[Ettin's Back]] and stop at Ventari's Refuge, near the middle. 

; Via [[mission]]s
Play through various missions in [[Prophecies]] to get to [[Bloodstone Fen (outpost)|Bloodstone Fen]], exit into Silverwood, and continue to Ventari's Refuge.

==Notes==
* Ventari's Refuge is the last actual outpost (not mission outpost) before [[Henge of Denravi]], which really marks the end of [[Maguuma Jungle]]. This is the start point for [[Totem Axe]] farming.
*Complete exploration of this outpost adds less than 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] Title.
